items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Doc, he don't know when he's well off. That's his trouble.

ctx.x: That boy's a fine trumpet player. I don't understand.

Doc, he don't know when he's well off. That's his trouble. That's right. He won't, uh, he thinks what he don't know, nobody else knows. But as far as travel and experience on the road, not only with bands, with shows, with, with almost every kind of entertainment, I could, uh, give them cards and spades and beat them because I, I, all in total, I spent about 12, 15 years just on the road alone. So I know it done good and well, yes.
What other, uh, businesses have you been in other than the musician business?
